verdict.rationale: Fireflies documents a first-party 'Rules Engine' that provides automation workflows, but the only evidence is a single security-page mention that limits it to admin control over meeting access and privacy. Webhooks and Zapier are developer building blocks or external tooling, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: documentation of how rules are defined (conditions/events/actions), event types beyond meeting access/privacy, a general-purpose action catalog, availability to non-admin users, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
